# Uniq Web Infotech

> Uniq Web Infotech is a digital marketing agency located in the Deep Himalayas, India, led by founder Anil Sharma. It offers SEO, Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and Pinterest ads, retargeting, landing pages, email marketing and automation for clients worldwide.

Key facts:

- Founder: Anil Sharma (https://anilsharma.co/), 14+ years in digital marketing; co-founder Ashwani Kumar
- 500+ clients worldwide and 5.0 stars on Upwork
- Results include Trampolines.com (about $2k to $1M+ a month in sales since 2017), PDQuipment, NOMI (10 to 400+ leads a month), Noemi Professional US and Shop Marlowe Street
- Sister company: Zorvex Technologies (https://zorvextechnologies.com/)
- Contact: info@uniqwebinfotech.com · +91 97793 39335

- [Conversion Rate & Lifetime Value](https://uniqwebinfotech.com/services/conversion-lifetime-value/): Get more from the traffic you already have. Conversion rate optimisation and customer lifetime value growth from Uniq Web Infotech. Free review.
- [Digital Marketing Consultation](https://uniqwebinfotech.com/services/marketing-consultation/): An honest review of your website, ads and marketing with a clear list of next steps. Book a free digital marketing consultation with Uniq Web Infotech.
- [Digital Marketing Strategy Services](https://uniqwebinfotech.com/services/marketing-strategy/): A practical digital marketing plan that connects your website, SEO, ads and email to your business goals. Built by Uniq Web Infotech. Get a free call.
- [Landing Page Design for Ads](https://uniqwebinfotech.com/services/landing-pages/): Fast, focused landing pages designed around one goal: the enquiry or sale. Built for Google, Meta and Pinterest ad traffic by Uniq Web Infotech.
- [Email Marketing Services](https://uniqwebinfotech.com/services/email-marketing/): Email campaigns and flows customers actually open. Uniq Web Infotech plans, writes and sends emails that bring buyers back and grow repeat sales.
